name: Gothic spire
_about: A GOTHIC SPIRE: an octagonal (`sides`) stone spire `R` to its corners and `rise` to its tip -- a straight cone (`profile` trigonal) whose sides would meet at `rise` -- cut off where it has narrowed to `topR` -- a small head for its `finial`, or wide enough for a gallery or a lantern to stand on; crocketed RIBS on its edges, a GABLE (Wimperg) at its foot on every face, and a PINNACLE at each corner round it. Place it on the head of the stage it crowns (a `gothic-octagon-stage`); gables and pinnacles stand on that stage's walls. It is a hollow shell of stone: a stair may climb inside it.

params._rise: where its sides would meet: it is cut off at radius `topR` (a small flat head for the finial, or a gallery's width)
params._shellT: the spire's stone: a shell, hollow inside (a stair may climb in it)
params._gR: the gables' radius: on the faces, over the walls under the spire's foot
params._pinR: the pinnacles' radius, at the corners

spire._about: the spire: a stone shell of `sides` webs, hollow

ribs._about: the crocketed ribs on its edges

gables._about: a gable at the foot of every face, turned to face out

pinnacles._about: a pinnacle at every corner round its foot
